# Coldspur Archival Vaults — service terms (extract)

Standard vault pull: segments ready on the confirmed date, business days. Expedited priority retrieval: USD 240 flat per request. Checksum verification by the customer's platform team is required before staging release; Coldspur does not release segments directly to release use.

Confirmations are valid until the date printed. Superseded confirmations (for example RQ-88102) must not be used for scheduling.
